handoff_instructions: M3-T08 done in one step. Added packages/domain/src/extraction.ts: FIELD_CAPTURE_FACT_TYPES, evidenceSpanSchema, fieldCaptureFactSchema (zod discriminated union on `type` for time_entry/equipment_usage/material_usage/job_note/billable_opportunity, each with raw unmatched ref fields, a per-field `confidence` record 0-1, and `evidence` evidence-span array requiring at least one span), unresolvedQuestionSchema, fieldCaptureExtractionSchema (facts[] + unresolvedQuestions[] default []), plus the provider-independent ExtractionInput/ExtractionResult<T>/StructuredExtractor<T> contract from ARCHITECTURE.md §8. Exported via packages/domain/src/index.ts (added one export line). Added packages/domain/test/extraction.test.ts (12 new tests) covering valid/invalid facts, confidence bounds, evidence requirement, unresolved-question defaults, and the full M3 acceptance-input shape (3 time/equipment facts + material + job note + billable opportunity). Only zod is imported — no vendor SDK. No DB/RLS/auth/side-effect surface introduced (pure types+schema, no persistence), so those checklist items are N/A. pnpm lint/typecheck/test all pass repo-wide (domain 40 tests, workspace total 260+ core, 36 integrations, 16 web, 9 agents, 1 workflows). Next: M3-T09 "Deterministic test extractor" — a fixture StructuredExtractor<FieldCaptureExtraction> (likely in packages/workflows) returning the M3 acceptance extraction validated against fieldCaptureExtractionSchema, for use by later workflow tests without any LLM call.
